final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which divided every amount by 100 and showed two decimals. Yen has no minor unit, so 500 came out as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`. I added a small set of zero-decimal currencies (currently only JPY). Amounts in those currencies are now shown as they are, with no division.

`formatMoney` is shared, so the cart totals and invoice lines also show yen correctly now. Nothing else in the codebase depended on the old yen output.
